# Stages

The default stage graph. This is *data*, not architecture: a factory may declare its
own, subject to the invariants `validate_graph` checks (FR-4.2a).

A stage marked non-skippable cannot be skipped on an agent's authority. Skipping needs
a principal holding `skip_stage`, and the approval is recorded against their identity.

Declared order: INTAKE → TRIAGE → DESIGN → BUILD → REVIEW → VERIFY → HANDOFF → COMPLETE

| Stage | May move to | Non-skippable |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `INTAKE` | `BLOCKED`, `BUILD`, `CANCELLED`, `DESIGN`, `REVIEW`, `TRIAGE` |  |
| `TRIAGE` | `BLOCKED`, `BUILD`, `CANCELLED`, `DESIGN`, `HANDOFF` |  |
| `DESIGN` | `BLOCKED`, `BUILD`, `CANCELLED`, `TRIAGE` |  |
| `BUILD` | `BLOCKED`, `CANCELLED`, `DESIGN`, `REVIEW` |  |
| `REVIEW` | `BLOCKED`, `BUILD`, `CANCELLED`, `HANDOFF`, `VERIFY` | **yes** |
| `VERIFY` | `BLOCKED`, `BUILD`, `CANCELLED`, `HANDOFF` |  |
| `HANDOFF` | `BLOCKED`, `BUILD`, `CANCELLED`, `COMPLETE` |  |
| `COMPLETE` | _terminal_ |  |
